description: Simple conformational change for dihedral SCAN and conformer-energy checks.
recommended_use: Dihedral SCAN sample with a familiar conformational reference.

reference_values.note: Common textbook value; gauche is higher than anti.
Approximate syn-eclipsed barrier; not a thermochemical DeltaG_activation.

oregon_state_butane_rotation.citation: Oregon State University, Butane rotation and conformational energy reference values.

notes: Use mainly for SCAN UI and dihedral-path smoke testing.
Coordinates were generated with RDKit/UFF and rounded to 0.001 Angstrom.
The _scan suffix means SCAN is the preferred initial-path mode, not the only supported mode.
